visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation style: Black and white line art with gray shading. A male character with short dark hair, wearing a dark tank top and a grey messenger bag, is seen riding an escalator up. He holds a cup with a straw in his left hand and takes a sip, maintaining a neutral, relaxed facial expression. The setting shows the structural lines of a mall or department store interior. (2) The camera angle shifts to show the man looking down at the opposite escalator descending. He spots two characters: a girl with cat ears and long brown hair holding a massive paper bag overflowing with fries and burgers, and a friend with black hair and glasses. The girl is in the middle of eating. (3) The man's face suddenly transforms into a dramatic glare with thick, angry eyebrows and a wide, shocked stare. The cat-eared girl notices him and instantly looks terrified, with white sweat beads appearing on her forehead and a nervous mouth expression as she realizes she's been caught. (4) As they pass each other, the man continues to stare intensely without moving. The girl frantically tries to hide the bag of fast food behind her back while the friend next to her continues to smile and look ahead. The background remains consistent with the escalator machinery and interior beams.
